p2-start.say: All right? Remember, you have one to two minutes for this, so don't worry if I stop you. I'll tell you when the time is up. Can you start speaking now, please?

end.say: Thank you. That is the end of the Speaking test.

questions.text: What do you do? Do you work or study?
questions.say: Good afternoon. My name is Lily, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about work or studies. What do you do? Do you work or study?

questions.text: Why did you choose that job, or that subject?
questions.say: Why did you choose that job, or that subject?

questions.text: What do you usually do during a break at work or school?
questions.say: What do you usually do during a break at work or school?

questions.text: Do you prefer to work alone or with other people?
questions.say: Do you prefer to work alone or with other people?

questions.text: How do you usually travel around your town?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about public transport. How do you usually travel around your town?

questions.text: Is public transport good where you live?
questions.say: Is public transport good where you live?

questions.text: Did you use public transport much as a child?
questions.say: Did you use public transport much as a child?

questions.text: Do you use maps when you travel?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about maps. Do you use maps when you travel?

questions.text: Do you prefer paper maps or maps on your phone?
questions.say: Do you prefer paper maps or maps on your phone?

questions.text: Were you taught how to read maps at school?
questions.say: Were you taught how to read maps at school?

cueCard.topic: Describe a memorable journey you have taken.
cueCard.explain: and explain why this journey was memorable.

questions.text: Describe a memorable journey you have taken.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a memorable journey you have taken. You should say: where you went; how you travelled; who you were with; and explain why this journey was memorable.

questions.text: Would you like to make the same journey again?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to make the same journey again?

questions.text: What are the most common ways of travelling long distances in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a memorable journey, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all transport. What are the most common ways of travelling long distances in your country?

questions.text: Why do some people prefer driving to taking public transport?
questions.say: Why do some people prefer driving to taking public transport?

questions.text: How could cities reduce the number of cars on their roads?
questions.say: How could cities reduce the number of cars on their roads?

questions.text: Do you think people will travel more or less in the future?
questions.say: Now let's talk about travel in the future. Do you think people will travel more or less in the future?

questions.text: How might new technology change the way we travel?
questions.say: How might new technology change the way we travel?

questions.text: Should air travel be made more expensive to protect the environment?
questions.say: Should air travel be made more expensive to protect the environment?
